rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The Federation Council calls the election of the President of the Russian Federation for 4 March 2012 (same constitutional and statutory citations as in 2007); in force on official publication. Signed V. I. Matvienko, Moscow, 25 November 2011, No. 442-SF.
